screens.name: Home — unavailable omen, collapsed and expanded policy

screens.name: Home — populated omen and room destinations

screens.name: Approach — normal, enlarged, focused and pressed

screens.name: Question composer — self and named-person, collapsed context

screens.name: Question composer — expanded context and retrieved disclosure

screens.name: Named-person selection — populated and corrected

screens.name: Named-person selection — empty and constrained

screens.name: Follow-up card 1 — unselected
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows three preparation choices, textual progress and a visibly disabled Continue at both text scales.

screens.name: Follow-up card 2 — unselected and selected

screens.name: Follow-up card 3 — unselected

screens.name: Single follow-up — unselected, focused, pressed and selected
screens.evidence: Sheets 19–21 and 29–30 show one- and two-option cards, distinct focus and press captures, and the selected radio state.

screens.name: Custom follow-up — empty other-input
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show the empty writing area, expansion action, explicit minimum-input guidance and disabled Continue.

screens.name: Custom follow-up — populated and constrained long answer

screens.name: Question composer — constrained typing and long question

screens.name: Expanded editors — question and custom answer, short and tall viewports

screens.name: Age confirmation — initial

screens.name: Birthday onboarding — optional and empty

screens.name: Age blocked — onboarding and birthday restriction

screens.name: Birthday correction — empty

screens.name: Focus onboarding — optional and unselected

screens.name: Birthday editing — partial and invalid date

limitations: These are provisional browser scores based on the attached stills, chronological filmstrips and supplied runtime report; I did not independently execute the reported checks or watch a video.

Corresponding transition, size and duplicate fixture captures are grouped with their settled functional state; visually distinct empty, error, loading, selected, expanded and populated states are included.
No confirmed hard-gate failure is established: cropped scroll content alone does not prove an unreachable action, and the supplied browser tests report reachability and full-text preservation.

Browser accessibility evidence includes reported contrast, keyboard, focus, enlargement, reduced-motion and axe checks; it does not establish complete assistive-technology usability or repeated novice success.
Physical iPhone/VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, OS sharing, notification delivery and native performance remain deferred without blanket score deductions.
Connected Circles behavior is not demonstrated; only its browser offline and retry states are graded.
Billing is simulated, navigator.share is mocked, and successful browser download evidence does not prove successful external sharing.
Synthetic and dense fixture wording is not treated as a production-copy defect, and neither fixtures nor a successful live reading establish predictive quality.
Filmstrips support visible continuity judgments, not frame-rate estimates; performance figures come only from the supplied separate timing measurements.
The supplied stationary-orb measurement establishes unchanged foreground bounds, not physical parallax or independently moving painted depth layers.
The requested threshold is not met: numerous demonstrated typography, grouping and scene-integration dimensions remain below 9, independently of deferred native verification.
topFixes: Improve room crossfades to avoid double-exposed architecture, and ground the Sky selector and golden halo in the painted lighting and materials.
Make long centered explanations easier to scan with shorter visual groups, clearer section boundaries and restrained publisher italics.
Compact enlarged disclosure, forecast, profile and plan layouts so related actions stay closer to their content.
Make inner scrolling unmistakable in enlarged writing fields and the clipboard-fallback URL field.
Unify selection-marker placement and simplify focus borders while preserving the demonstrated keyboard visibility.
Differentiate disclosure rows from primary wood buttons and reduce repetitive heavy shadows across parchment choices.
